description_en: Queries the access overview for a consumer
name: GetConsumerAccessOverview

parameters.help_en: The consumer ID, which is the identifier returned by the consumer creation or query API operation
parameters.help_zh: 消费者 ID，使用消费者创建或查询接口返回的标识
parameters.name: consumer_id

parameters.help_en: The target AI gateway instance ID. Quotas and resources are isolated by instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标AI网关实例ID；额度与资源按实例隔离
parameters.name: gateway_id

code.description_en: The response status code. Ok is returned upon success, and a specific business error code is returned upon failure
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business result returned by the consumer operation
data.description_zh: 消费者操作返回的业务结果

complete.description_en: Indicates whether the query result is complete. A successful response returns a complete projection
complete.description_zh: 查询结果是否完整；成功响应返回完整投影

gateway.description_en: The identifier and name of the gateway in the current context
gateway.description_zh: 当前视角的网关标识及名称

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID

identityDescription.description_en: The description text of the consumer
identityDescription.example: 用于业务应用的消费者。

impacts.description_en: The impact of the authorization configuration for this consumer on readable gateways in the local region
impacts.description_zh: 该消费者在本地域可读网关中的授权配置影响

authorizationCounts.description_en: The number of authorization configurations counted by resource type
authorizationCounts.description_zh: 按资源类型统计的授权配置数量

agentApis.description_en: The number of agent APIs with configured authorization
agentApis.description_zh: 已配置授权的 Agent API 数量

mcpServers.description_en: The number of MCP servers with configured authorization
mcpServers.description_zh: 已配置授权的 MCP 服务数量

modelApis.description_en: The number of model APIs with configured authorization
modelApis.description_zh: 已配置授权的模型 API 数量

gateway.description_en: The identifier and name of the gateway in the current context
gateway.description_zh: 当前视角的网关标识及名称

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID

resources.description_en: The set of resources authorized for the consumer
resources.description_zh: 消费者已经配置授权的资源集合

items.description_en: The name of an affected authorized resource
items.description_zh: 一个受影响授权资源的名称

quotas.description_en: The quota rules and usage of the consumer and its consumer group
quotas.description_zh: 消费者本身及所属消费者组的配额规则和用量

limit.description_en: The quota limit for the current rule, measured in the same unit as the unit field
limit.description_zh: 当前规则的配额上限，与 unit 字段使用相同计量单位

periodMultiplier.description_en: The multiplier for the custom period

periodType.description_en: The quota period type, which can be day, week, or month
periodType.description_zh: 配额周期类型，day、week、month 分别表示日、周、月

subjectId.description_en: The ID of the subject to which the quota belongs

subjectName.description_en: The name of the subject to which the quota belongs

subjectType.description_en: The quota subject type, which can be consumer or consumer_group
subjectType.description_zh: 配额主体类型，consumer 为消费者，consumer_group 为消费者组

used.description_en: The used quota within the period corresponding to the current rule, measured in the same unit as the unit field
used.description_zh: 当前规则对应周期内已经使用的额度，与 unit 字段使用相同计量单位

windowAlignment.description_en: The alignment method of the period window, which can be calendar for a natural period or epoch for a custom base period
windowAlignment.description_zh: 周期窗口的对齐方式，calendar 为自然周期，epoch 为自定义基准周期

resources.description_en: The set of resources authorized for the consumer
resources.description_zh: 消费者已经配置授权的资源集合

allModels.description_en: Specifies whether the authorization scope of this resource includes all models
allModels.description_zh: 该资源的授权范围是否包含全部模型

allTools.description_en: Specifies whether the authorization scope of this MCP resource includes all tools
allTools.description_zh: 该 MCP 资源的授权范围是否包含全部工具

consumerGroupName.description_en: The name of the consumer group that provides this authorization
consumerGroupName.description_zh: 提供该项授权的消费者组名称

entitlementState.description_en: The existing desired or applied state of the model entitlement projection. This field is omitted when no state row exists
entitlementState.description_zh: 模型许可投影的既有desired/applied状态；无状态行时省略

desiredRevision.description_en: The desired authorization revision number to be delivered
desiredRevision.description_zh: 需要下发的期望授权修订号

errorMessage.description_en: The error description when processing fails. This field is empty when no error occurs
errorMessage.description_zh: 处理失败时的错误说明；没有错误时为空

status.description_en: The status, which can be Pending, Applying, Committed, or Failed

entitlementState.title_en: 模型许可投影的既有desired/applied状态；无状态行时省略。
entitlementState.title_zh: 模型许可投影的既有desired/applied状态；无状态行时省略。

expireTime.description_en: The expiration time. The value is null for long-term authorization, an RFC 3339 formatted string for short-term authorization that can be losslessly projected, and omitted when unknown
expireTime.description_zh: 长期授权为null；短期且可无损投影时为RFC3339；未知时省略
expireTime.title_en: 长期授权为null；短期且可无损投影时为RFC3339；未知时省略。
expireTime.title_zh: 长期授权为null；短期且可无损投影时为RFC3339；未知时省略。

modelGroups.description_zh: 可访问的模型组及其模型集合

consumerGroupName.description_zh: 提供该项授权的消费者组名称

modelGroupId.description_zh: 模型组 ID，使用 CreateModelGroup 返回的 modelGroupId

modelSourceId.description_zh: 模型源 ID，使用 CreateAiModelSource 返回的 modelSourceId
